description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
